caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted bust of a horse rendered in shades of brown and gray, with visible texture suggesting a metallic or stone surface. The horse's head is shown in profile facing to the right, adorned with a bridle with visible buckles and a circular decorative element near the ear. The mane is short and follows the contour along the neck. Near the base, there is decorative foliage and another round, raised element. The bust sits on a circular plinth, and a large metal ring is attached to a circular mount on the lower right side of the base. The background is plain and a light beige color, with the central rectangular area more saturated, drawing attention to the horse bust.
title: Hitching Post
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
